userId.description: Id of the user to associate.

role.description: Role in this association. On a PROJECT it OVERRIDES the workspace role in both directions — the effective role is this one whenever the association exists, higher OR lower — and two movements are refused with 403: downgrading a workspace `owner`, and changing your own role (either way). On a WORKSPACE it is simply the role, with only the second of those caps: you cannot change your own.
